task_title: Extend Sweep Results Viewer for AI Sweep Eval with live phase progress and deep-link

plan_review.notes: Reviewer raised 2 blocking + 3 non-blocking concerns. (1) Blocking: stabilizeTerminalSnapshot used weapon-sweep-only fields (expectedWeapons/aggregateOutputs) for AI sweeps — fixed via optional isComplete callback with weapon-sweep default behavior. (2) Blocking: listAllSweepRuns masked errors when one workflow failed and other returned no runs — fixed by throwing on empty combined list if any listing failed; also extracted pure mergeSweepRunResults helper for testability. (3) Non-blocking: expired AI leaderboard artifacts not surfaced in aiSweepWarning — fixed by adding expiredArtifactCount parameter. (4) Non-blocking: winnersDiverge showed only composite table — fixed to render both byComposite and byLexicographic tables. (5) Suggestion: missing test coverage for expired warning, AI stabilization, and listAllSweepRuns error paths — added 7 new tests covering all three. No re-architecture was warranted; all changes were focused fixes within the existing design.
